module: Node "Match String" (simple). Should return the first capture of a Lua pattern applied to the input string; pins: value (in, string), value (out, string). Pattern in data.pattern ("%d" by default).
notes: Bug: work uses self.data.pattern.value whereas data.pattern is a string: indexing a string by 'value' gives nil, string.match receives a nil pattern and raises an error.
The file notes as a todo that the usable patterns remain to be documented.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Calls string.match(value, data.pattern.value) and writes the result.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the editor.
